verses.text_uthmani: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلذَّٰرِيَٰتِ ذَرْوًۭا
verses.transliteration: Waz-zaariyaati zarwaa

translations.text: By those [winds] scattering [dust] dispersing

verses.text_uthmani: فَٱلْحَٰمِلَٰتِ وِقْرًۭا
verses.transliteration: Falhaamilaati wiqraa

translations.text: And those [clouds] carrying a load [of water]

verses.text_uthmani: فَٱلْجَٰرِيَٰتِ يُسْرًۭا
verses.transliteration: Faljaariyaati yusraa

translations.text: And those [ships] sailing with ease

verses.text_uthmani: فَٱلْمُقَسِّمَٰتِ أَمْرًا
verses.transliteration: Falmuqassimaati amraa

translations.text: And those [angels] apportioning [each] matter,

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَصَادِقٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Innamaa too'adoona la-saadiq

translations.text: Indeed, what you are promised is true.

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ ٱلدِّينَ لَوَٰقِعٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Wa innad deena la waaqi'

translations.text: And indeed, the recompense is to occur.

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلْحُبُكِ
verses.transliteration: Wassamaaa'i zaatil hubuk

translations.text: By the heaven containing pathways,

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّكُمْ لَفِى قَوْلٍۢ مُّخْتَلِفٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Innakum lafee qawlim mukhtalif

translations.text: Indeed, you are in differing speech.

verses.text_uthmani: يُؤْفَكُ عَنْهُ مَنْ أُفِكَ
verses.transliteration: Yu'faku 'anhu man ufik

translations.text: Deluded away from the Qur'an is he who is deluded.

verses.text_uthmani: قُتِلَ ٱلْخَرَّٰصُونَ
verses.transliteration: Qutilal kharraasoon

translations.text: Destroyed are the falsifiers

verses.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى غَمْرَةٍۢ سَاهُونَ
verses.transliteration: Allazeena hum fee ghamratin saahoon

translations.text: Who are within a flood [of confusion] and heedless.

verses.text_uthmani: يَسْـَٔلُونَ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
verses.transliteration: Yas'aloona ayyaana yawmud Deen

translations.text: They ask, "When is the Day of Recompense?"

verses.text_uthmani: يَوْمَ هُمْ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ يُفْتَنُونَ
verses.transliteration: Yawma hum 'alan naari yuftanoon

translations.text: [It is] the Day they will be tormented over the Fire

verses.text_uthmani: ذُوقُوا۟ فِتْنَتَكُمْ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Zooqoo fitnatakum haa zal lazee kuntum bihee tas ta'jiloon

translations.text: [And will be told], "Taste your torment. This is that for which you were impatient."

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَعُيُونٍ
verses.transliteration: Innal muttaqeena fee jannaatinw wa 'uyoon

translations.text: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and springs,

verses.text_uthmani: ءَاخِذِينَ مَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَبْلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُحْسِنِينَ
verses.transliteration: Aakhizeena maaa aataahum Rabbuhum; innahum kaanoo qabla zaalika muhsineen

translations.text: Accepting what their Lord has given them. Indeed, they were before that doers of good.

verses.text_uthmani: كَانُوا۟ قَلِيلًۭا مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ مَا يَهْجَعُونَ
verses.transliteration: kaanoo qaleelam minal laili maa yahja'oon

translations.text: They used to sleep but little of the night,

verses.text_uthmani: وَبِٱلْأَسْحَارِ هُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wa bilashaari hum yastaghfiroon

translations.text: And in the hours before dawn they would ask forgiveness,

verses.text_uthmani: وَفِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ حَقٌّۭ لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلْمَحْرُومِ
verses.transliteration: Wa feee amwaalihim haqqul lissaaa'ili walmahroom

translations.text: And from their properties was [given] the right of the [needy] petitioner and the deprived.

verses.text_uthmani: وَفِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ءَايَٰتٌۭ لِّلْمُوقِنِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wa fil ardi aayaatul lilmooqineen

translations.text: And on the earth are signs for the certain [in faith]

verses.text_uthmani: وَفِىٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ ۚ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wa feee anfusikum; afalaa tubsiroon

translations.text: And in yourselves. Then will you not see?

verses.text_uthmani: وَفِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ رِزْقُكُمْ وَمَا تُوعَدُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wa fissamaaa'i rizqukum wa maa too'adoon

translations.text: And in the heaven is your provision and whatever you are promised.

verses.text_uthmani: فَوَرَبِّ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِنَّهُۥ لَحَقٌّۭ مِّثْلَ مَآ أَنَّكُمْ تَنطِقُونَ
verses.transliteration: Fawa Rabbis samaaa'i wal ardi innahoo lahaqqum misla maa annakum tantiqoon

translations.text: Then by the Lord of the heaven and earth, indeed, it is truth - just as [sure as] it is that you are speaking.

verses.text_uthmani: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ضَيْفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ٱلْمُكْرَمِينَ
verses.transliteration: Hal ataaka hadeesu daifi Ibraaheemal mukrameen

translations.text: Has there reached you the story of the honored guests of Abraham? -

verses.text_uthmani: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا۟ سَلَٰمًۭا ۖ قَالَ سَلَٰمٌۭ قَوْمٌۭ مُّنكَرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Iz dakhaloo 'alaihi faqaaloo salaaman qaala salaamun qawmum munkaroon

translations.text: When they entered upon him and said, "[We greet you with] peace." He answered, "[And upon you] peace, [you are] a people unknown.

verses.text_uthmani: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ فَجَآءَ بِعِجْلٍۢ سَمِينٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Faraagha ilaaa ahlihee fajaaa'a bi'ijlin sameen

translations.text: Then he went to his family and came with a fat [roasted] calf

verses.text_uthmani: فَقَرَّبَهُۥٓ إِلَيْهِمْ قَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Faqarrabahooo ilaihim qaala alaa taakuloon

translations.text: And placed it near them; he said, "Will you not eat?"

verses.text_uthmani: فَأَوْجَسَ مِنْهُمْ خِيفَةًۭ ۖ قَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ ۖ وَبَشَّرُوهُ بِغُلَٰمٍ عَلِيمٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Fa awjasa minhm khee fatan qaaloo laa takhaf wa bashsharoohu bighulaamin 'aleem

translations.text: And he felt from them apprehension. They said, "Fear not," and gave him good tidings of a learned boy.

verses.text_uthmani: فَأَقْبَلَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُهُۥ فِى صَرَّةٍۢ فَصَكَّتْ وَجْهَهَا وَقَالَتْ عَجُوزٌ عَقِيمٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Fa aqbalatim ra-atuhoo fee sarratin fasakkat wajhahaa wa qaalat 'ajoozun 'aqeem

translations.text: And his wife approached with a cry [of alarm] and struck her face and said, "[I am] a barren old woman!"

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verses.transliteration: Qaaloo kazaaliki qaala Rabbuki innahoo huwal hakeemul 'aleem

translations.text: They said, "Thus has said your Lord; indeed, He is the Wise, the Knowing."

verses.text_uthmani: ۞ قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Qaala famaa khatbukum ayyuhal mursaloon

translations.text: [Abraham] said, "Then what is your business [here], O messengers?"

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍۢ مُّجْرِمِينَ
verses.transliteration: Qaalooo innaaa ursilnaaa ilaa qawmim mujrimeen

translations.text: They said, "Indeed, we have been sent to a people of criminals

verses.text_uthmani: لِنُرْسِلَ عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةًۭ مِّن طِينٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Linursila 'alaihim hijaa ratam min teen

translations.text: To send down upon them stones of clay,

verses.text_uthmani: مُّسَوَّمَةً عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُسْرِفِينَ
verses.transliteration: Musawwamatan 'inda rabbika lilmusrifeen

translations.text: Marked in the presence of your Lord for the transgressors."

verses.text_uthmani: فَأَخْرَجْنَا مَن كَانَ فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.transliteration: Fa akhrajnaa man kaana feehaa minal mu'mineen

translations.text: So We brought out whoever was in the cities of the believers.

verses.text_uthmani: فَمَا وَجَدْنَا فِيهَا غَيْرَ بَيْتٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
verses.transliteration: Famaa wajadnaa feehaa ghaira baitim minal muslimeen

translations.text: And We found not within them other than a [single] house of Muslims.

verses.text_uthmani: وَتَرَكْنَا فِيهَآ ءَايَةًۭ لِّلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ
verses.transliteration: Wa taraknaa feehaaa aayatal lillazeena yakhaafoonal 'azaabal aleem

translations.text: And We left therein a sign for those who fear the painful punishment.

verses.text_uthmani: وَفِى مُوسَىٰٓ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَٰهُ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ بِسُلْطَٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Wa fee Moosaaa iz arsalnaahu ilaa Fir'wna bisultaa nim mubeen

translations.text: And in Moses [was a sign], when We sent him to Pharaoh with clear authority.

verses.text_uthmani: فَتَوَلَّىٰ بِرُكْنِهِۦ وَقَالَ سَٰحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Fatawalla biruknihee wa qaala saahirun aw majnoon

translations.text: But he turned away with his supporters and said," A magician or a madman."

verses.text_uthmani: فَأَخَذْنَٰهُ وَجُنُودَهُۥ فَنَبَذْنَٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Fa akhaznaahu wa junoo dahoo fanabaznaahum fil yammi wa huwa muleem

translations.text: So We took him and his soldiers and cast them into the sea, and he was blameworthy.

verses.text_uthmani: وَفِى عَادٍ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلرِّيحَ ٱلْعَقِيمَ
verses.transliteration: Wa fee 'Aadin iz arsalnaa 'alaihimur reehal'aqeem

translations.text: And in 'Aad [was a sign], when We sent against them the barren wind.

verses.text_uthmani: مَا تَذَرُ مِن شَىْءٍ أَتَتْ عَلَيْهِ إِلَّا جَعَلَتْهُ كَٱلرَّمِيمِ
verses.transliteration: Maa tazaru min shai'in atat 'alaihi illaa ja'alat hu karrameem

translations.text: It left nothing of what it came upon but that it made it like disintegrated ruins.

verses.text_uthmani: وَفِى ثَمُودَ إِذْ قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَمَتَّعُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Wa fee Samooda iz qeela lahum tamatta''oo hattaa heen

translations.text: And in Thamud, when it was said to them, "Enjoy yourselves for a time."

verses.text_uthmani: فَعَتَوْا۟ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّٰعِقَةُ وَهُمْ يَنظُرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Fa'ataw 'an amri Rabbihim fa akhazal humus saa'iqatu wa hum yanzuroon

translations.text: But they were insolent toward the command of their Lord, so the thunderbolt seized them while they were looking on.

verses.text_uthmani: فَمَا ٱسْتَطَٰعُوا۟ مِن قِيَامٍۢ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنتَصِرِينَ
verses.transliteration: Famas tataa'oo min qiyaaminw wa maa kaanoo muntasireen

translations.text: And they were unable to arise, nor could they defend themselves.

verses.text_uthmani: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍۢ مِّن قَبْلُ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمًۭا فَٰسِقِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wa qawma Noohim min qablu innahum kaano qawman faasiqeen

translations.text: And [We destroyed] the people of Noah before; indeed, they were a people defiantly disobedient.

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ بَنَيْنَٰهَا بِأَيْي۟دٍۢ وَإِنَّا لَمُوسِعُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wassamaaa'a banainaa haa bi aydinw wa innaa lamoosi'oon

translations.text: And the heaven We constructed with strength, and indeed, We are [its] expander.

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلْأَرْضَ فَرَشْنَٰهَا فَنِعْمَ ٱلْمَٰهِدُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wal arda farashnaahaa fani'mal maahidoon

translations.text: And the earth We have spread out, and excellent is the preparer.

verses.text_uthmani: وَمِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَا زَوْجَيْنِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wa min kulli shai'in khalaqnaa zawjaini la'allakum tazakkaroon

translations.text: And of all things We created two mates; perhaps you will remember.

verses.text_uthmani: فَفِرُّوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Fafirrooo ilal laahi innee lakum minhu nazeerum mubeen

translations.text: So flee to Allah. Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner.

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَا تَجْعَلُوا۟ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Wa laa taj'aloo ma'al laahi ilaahan aakhara innee lakum minhu nazeerum mubeen

translations.text: And do not make [as equal] with Allah another deity. Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner.

verses.text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ مَآ أَتَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا قَالُوا۟ سَاحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ
verses.transliteration: Kazaalika maaa atal lazeena min qablihim mir Rasoolin illaa qaaloo saahirun aw majnoon

translations.text: Similarly, there came not to those before them any messenger except that they said, "A magician or a madman."

verses.text_uthmani: أَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِهِۦ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌۭ طَاغُونَ
verses.transliteration: Atawaasaw bih; bal hum qawmun taaghoon

translations.text: Did they suggest it to them? Rather, they [themselves] are a transgressing people.

verses.text_uthmani: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِمَلُومٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Fatawalla 'anhum famaaa anta bimaloom

translations.text: So leave them, [O Muhammad], for you are not to be blamed.

verses.text_uthmani: وَذَكِّرْ فَإِنَّ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ تَنفَعُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wa zakkir fa innaz zikraa tanfa'ul mu'mineen

translations.text: And remind, for indeed, the reminder benefits the believers.

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَا خَلَقْتُ ٱلْجِنَّ وَٱلْإِنسَ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُونِ
verses.transliteration: Wa maa khalaqtul jinna wal insa illaa liya'budoon

translations.text: And I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me.

verses.text_uthmani: مَآ أُرِيدُ مِنْهُم مِّن رِّزْقٍۢ وَمَآ أُرِيدُ أَن يُطْعِمُونِ
verses.transliteration: Maaa ureedu minhum mir rizqinw wa maaa ureedu anyyut'imoon

translations.text: I do not want from them any provision, nor do I want them to feed Me.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلرَّزَّاقُ ذُو ٱلْقُوَّةِ ٱلْمَتِينُ
verses.transliteration: Innal laaha Huwar Razzaaqu Zul Quwwatil Mateen

translations.text: Indeed, it is Allah who is the [continual] Provider, the firm possessor of strength.

verses.text_uthmani: فَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ذَنُوبًۭا مِّثْلَ ذَنُوبِ أَصْحَٰبِهِمْ فَلَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونِ
verses.transliteration: Fa inna lillazeena zalamoo zanoobam misla zanoobi ashaabihim falaa yasta'jiloon

translations.text: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a portion [of punishment] like the portion of their predecessors, so let them not impatiently urge Me.

verses.text_uthmani: فَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن يَوْمِهِمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ
verses.transliteration: Fawailul lillazeena kafaroo miny yawmihimul lazee yoo'adoon

translations.text: And woe to those who have disbelieved from their Day which they are promised.
